 what we offer

 who you are 
As a Cleanroom Technician, you guarantee top quality. You easily recognize yourself in the following points: - You have a VMBO+ or MBO level of working and thinking - You have well-developed technical insight - You work with extreme precision, structure, and accuracy - You communicate easily in Dutch or English - You are physically fit and enjoy staying active 
 what will you do

Consultancy at Vicoma 
In the Consultancy department, you work on, for example, an investment plan, technical concept or tender for the next phase of a project. You focus on defining the scope, weighing strategic risks, analysing the payback period and creating the business case. You also take into account matters such as the impact of (future) regulations, sustainability goals, operational reliability and safety. If there are multiple options to achieve the set goal, you are the one who can advise the customer.
